Geometry and bounding box of an area of interest

Source: R/aoi.R
aoi_geom.Rd

Geometry and bounding box of an area of interest

Usage

aoi_geom(aoi, crs = CRS_PL1992)

aoi_bbox(aoi, crs = CRS_PL1992, by_feature = FALSE)

Arguments

aoi

An `rgeopl_aoi` object, or anything [as_aoi()] accepts.

crs

Target CRS. Defaults to EPSG:2180, the CRS the GUGiK services use natively.

by_feature

When `TRUE`, return one bounding box per feature instead of a single box around all of them. Useful for scattered areas, where one overall box would cover far more ground than was asked for.

Value

`aoi_geom()` an `sfc`; `aoi_bbox()` a named numeric vector (`xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`), or a list of them when `by_feature`.

Examples

aoi <- as_aoi(c(16.93, 52.41), buffer = 250)
aoi_bbox(aoi)
#>     xmin     ymin     xmax     ymax 
#> 358995.4 506663.6 359495.4 507163.6 
aoi_bbox(aoi, crs = 4326)
#>     xmin     ymin     xmax     ymax 
#> 16.92633 52.40775 16.93367 52.41225
